name: Lightning Blessed
body:
Drawbacks
Lightning Blessed
Source Kobolds of Golarion pg. 18
Category Race
Requirement(s) Kobold
You’re favored by the lightning shaman of your tribe, and he gifted you several sacred items as a reminder of your origins. You begin play with three vials of bottled lighting (Ultimate Equipment 106). These don’t count against your starting character wealth.
